FORM.notes: source note: makasin亦可說masin，可指現在或現代。 | source note: sua isi ia, makasin tamna nonoman 這是現代的東西。 | source note: 其他和po-"說"相關的詞彙：po-nasʉ"講確定"；po-cucuru"說真話/相信"。

S.FORM: makasin ia eh iku masin ia teku poisua aracakan.
S.PHON: makasin ia eh iku masin ia teku poisua a[r|ɾ]aʦakan
S.FORM: makasin ia eh iku masin ia teku poisua aracakan.
S.PHON: makasin ia eh iku masin ia teku poisua a[r|ɾ]aʦakan
S.TRANSL: 現在呢,我現在要說關於狩獵的事.
Now, I am going to talk about hunting.

FORM.notes: source note: 年長者詞根為marang，複數重疊可有mamarang或mamarurang，但無*marurang。 | source note: muaca和moca為free variation。 | source note: =pa為"先去做什麼"的語意。 | source note: mocan原意為"走"，此處在musa前，兩者合一有"趕著去"的語意。 | source note: rʉmʉra指山中有樹有雜草未開墾之處。 | source note: aririan 專指"側聽"，不讓發聲者發現，有秘密性，並且仔細的聽。 | source note: aririan sua sisin 字面上為"側聽畫眉鳥"，此處譯為"側聽畫眉鳥的聲音"。後者字面上可說aririan sua sisin tamna riang。 | source note: 目前無法確認aririan的焦點，有下列兩句的對比，但仍無法判斷是否為主焦或非主焦：(1) aririan=ku sua sisin tamna riang; (2) *aririan=maku sua sisin tamna riang。

S.FORM: miana mamarurang nuu aracakan ia uaca muacapa m uh mocan musa rʉmʉra aririan sua uh sisin.
S.PHON: miana mama[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋ nuu a[r|ɾ]aʦakan ia uaʦa muaʦapa m uh moʦan musa [r|ɾ]ɨmɨ[r|ɾ]a a[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]ian sua uh sisin
S.FORM: miana mamarurang nuu aracakan ia uaca muacapa m uh mocan musa rʉmʉra aririan sua uh sisin.
S.PHON: miana mama[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋ nuu a[r|ɾ]aʦakan ia uaʦa muaʦapa m uh moʦan musa [r|ɾ]ɨmɨ[r|ɾ]a a[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]ian sua uh sisin
S.TRANSL: 過去年長者若要狩獵,會先趕去叢林,側聽畫眉鳥的聲音.
In the past, if the elders go hunting, they would rush to the forest first, and eavesdrop on the sound made by the Melodious Laughingthrush.

W.TRANSL: Ca重疊-年長者-Ca重疊-年長者

FORM.notes: source note: nuu 和 noo 為free variation，皆為"如果"。 | source note: nuu/noo 和 =in 為"如果"的兩種語法表現形式，兩者可同時出現，亦可單獨出現。如：(1) noo mamanUng=in; (2) noo mamanUng; (3) mamanUng=in，三句皆為”若很好”。 | source note: 若另有代名詞clitic黏著在動詞後，則 =in 'if' 跟著黏著在該代名詞後。如：noo una=ku=in vantuku '我若有錢'。 | source note: noo tapinangi=in=ku “若我是小鳥”。 | source note: noo tapinange/tapinangi=in ia tavarU’U minange 若是小鳥，就能飛。 | source note: Kanakanavu族人打獵前需側聽畫眉鳥的聲音，聲音若好（也就是叫聲清脆、不疾不徐），則是好兆頭，可以進行打獵；聲音若不好（也就是叫聲急促、吵雜），則不適合打獵，須返回。 | source note: 除了叫聲以外，亦可觀察前往探視的畫眉鳥飛行的方向。若畫眉鳥在觀察者的右側，順著其前進的方向向前飛行，則是第一好的兆頭。若是在觀察者的左側，並且一樣順著觀察者前進的方向飛行，是次好的兆頭。若是畫眉鳥由觀察者的左側往右側飛行，則是不好的兆頭。最不好的兆頭，是畫眉鳥毫無規則、雜亂無章地亂飛，表示不可打獵，須返回。 | source note: nokai(或nukai)應為noo ka'an=in '若不好' 的縮減。因此此處可分解為noo ka'an=in mamanUng ia pu'i。 | source note: pu'i tanasa為"返回家裡"，mo-tanasa (go-house)，為"回家"。 | source note: 此IU發音老師一開始認為是 pu'i tan-tanasa，為回到各自的家(tan-tanasa 'RED-house')。但後發現應為pu'i=pa tanasa，因此修正轉寫和翻譯。

S.FORM: nuu mamanʉngin a nuu mamanʉngin a sisin ia muaca nukai mamanʉng ia pu'i pu'ipa tanasa.
S.PHON: nuu mamanɨŋin a nuu mamanɨŋin a sisin ia muaʦa nukai mamanɨŋ ia puʔi puʔipa tanasa
S.FORM: nuu mamanʉngin a nuu mamanʉngin a sisin ia muaca nukai mamanʉng ia pu'i pu'ipa tanasa.
S.PHON: nuu mamanɨŋin a nuu mamanɨŋin a sisin ia muaʦa nukai mamanɨŋ ia puʔi puʔipa tanasa
S.TRANSL: 如果畫眉鳥的聲音好的話,就走,如果不好的話,就先返回.
If the sound of the Melodious Laughing thrushes is good, they would proceed; if the sound is not good, they would return to their houses first.

FORM.notes: source note: =cu 為表狀態改變(change of state)，目前暫時標語助詞。

S.FORM: uh taniara s nuu karanana taniara muaca nuu mamanʉngin ia mo muacacu.
S.PHON: uh tania[r|ɾ]a s nuu ka[r|ɾ]anana tania[r|ɾ]a muaʦa nuu mamanɨŋin ia mo muaʦaʦu
S.FORM: uh taniara s nuu karanana taniara muaca nuu mamanʉngin ia mo muacacu.
S.PHON: uh tania[r|ɾ]a s nuu ka[r|ɾ]anana tania[r|ɾ]a muaʦa nuu mamanɨŋin ia mo muaʦaʦu
S.TRANSL: 如果不同的日子去,如果聲音好的話,就去了.
If they go on a different day, and if the sound is good, they would then proceed to hunt.

FORM.notes: source note: taruan 原指工寮，此處應指獵寮。 | source note: 此處=in "它" 應指"打獵"此事件。此句可解釋為歧義(ambiguous)，因發音老師提供兩種翻譯：(1) 要在狩獵的地方，在它的位置製作工寮； (2) 要到它的地方狩獵，在它的位置製作工寮。

S.FORM: mokusa sia tu tu'unain eh uh tia tu'unain aracakan tia tu'unain katataruan.
S.PHON: mokusa sia tu tuʔunain eh uh tia tuʔunain a[r|ɾ]aʦakan tia tuʔunain katata[r|ɾ]uan
S.FORM: mokusa sia tu tu'unain eh uh tia tu'unain aracakan tia tu'unain katataruan.
S.PHON: mokusa sia tu tuʔunain eh uh tia tuʔunain a[r|ɾ]aʦakan tia tuʔunain katata[r|ɾ]uan
S.TRANSL: 要到它狩獵的地方,在它的位置製作工寮.
(The hunter) will go to its place where he hunts to build a shed.

FORM.notes: source note: nia等同 'inia "那邊"。 | source note: urupaca為 "使用" 做主動詞時的形式。siarupaca為 "要使用的"，因為音變的關係亦有serupaca的形式。但此IU發音人是用si-rupa-in，詞根簡化為rupa，並且加上後綴關係詞-in。 | source note: -in 'REL' 和 =in 'if' 以及 =in '3SG.POSS' 需區分。 | source note: rʉmʉnge應為發音人口誤，應為ringee "陷阱"。 | source note: ringee亦可唸為ringai，兩者應為free variation。 | source note: tarʉ ringee指如同墊子/床一般的陷阱。使用方式為在地上挖洞，並且在上面鋪一層墊子，偽裝成平地，等待獵物經過，便會掉入洞中。

S.FORM: nuu mosaci nia mosacu nia katataruan uN kamanʉng sua tia sirupain rʉmʉnge tarʉ tarʉ ringee.
S.PHON: nuu mosaʦi nia mosaʦu nia katata[r|ɾ]uan un kamanɨŋ sua tia si[r|ɾ]upain [r|ɾ]ɨmɨŋe ta[r|ɾ]ɨ ta[r|ɾ]ɨ [r|ɾ]iŋee
S.FORM: nuu mosaci nia mosacu nia katataruan uN kamanʉng sua tia sirupain rʉmʉnge tarʉ tarʉ ringee.
S.PHON: nuu mosaʦi nia mosaʦu nia katata[r|ɾ]uan un kamanɨŋ sua tia si[r|ɾ]upain [r|ɾ]ɨmɨŋe ta[r|ɾ]ɨ ta[r|ɾ]ɨ [r|ɾ]iŋee
S.TRANSL: 去那裏建造獵寮,製作要使用的陷阱.
(The hunter) would go there to build a shed, and make cushion traps that are going to be used.

FORM.notes: source note: 此IU中masi為發音人口誤，應為masin。 | source note: nura=ci ia為"明天之後"之意。 | source note: 根據上下文，此IU應有被後續的IU修正。因此不採納進翻譯中。 | source note: nuu nura ia可以有"明天的話"或"明天的時候"兩種語意，但沒有"若是明天"的語意。 | source note: rumingee為"放陷阱"。但較常見的形式為r<um>a-ringee (<AF>RED-trap)。

S.FORM: masin masici ia nuu n nura ia muacacu rumingee.
S.PHON: masin masiʦi ia nuu n nu[r|ɾ]a ia muaʦaʦu [r|ɾ]umiŋee
S.FORM: masin masici ia nuu n nura ia muacacu rumingee.
S.PHON: masin masiʦi ia nuu n nu[r|ɾ]a ia muaʦaʦu [r|ɾ]umiŋee
S.TRANSL: 明天的時候,就走去放陷阱.
On the next day, (they) would then go and set up traps.

FORM.notes: source note: r<um>ingee=en中的=en由=in 'if' 因黏著在長音ee後產生音變而來。 | source note: r<um>ingee=en中的=en由=in 'if' 因黏著在長音ee後產生音變而來。 | source note: c<ʉm>ʉ'ʉra中的主焦中綴<um>因母音和諧的關係轉化為<ʉm>。 | source note: c<um>a-cʉ'ʉra (<AV>RED-see) 亦為"看"主焦的另一種形式。 | source note: ramang指由動物足跡所形成的路線。是因獵物經常走過，有痕跡可循，漸漸形成一條動物行經的路線，所留下的線索。亦可譯為"機會"。 | source note: ramang需和anuka區分，後者專指動物腳踏過的痕跡、腳印，而前者指足跡所形成的路線。 | source note: c<ʉm>ʉ'ʉra中的主焦中綴<um>因母音和諧的關係轉化為<ʉm>。 | source note: c<um>a-cʉ'ʉra (<AV>RED-see) 亦為"看"主焦的另一種形式。 | source note: "野獸"詞根為marʉkurapʉ，複數為由倒數第二和第三兩音節(kura)向左重疊而形成。

S.FORM: rumingeeen nuu mocacan rumingee cʉmʉ'ʉra sua ramang marʉkurakurapʉ.
S.PHON: [r|ɾ]umiŋeeen nuu moʦaʦan [r|ɾ]umiŋee ʦɨmɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a sua [r|ɾ]amaŋ ma[r|ɾ]ɨku[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]apɨ
S.FORM: rumingeeen nuu mocacan rumingee cʉmʉ'ʉra sua ramang marʉkurakurapʉ.
S.PHON: [r|ɾ]umiŋeeen nuu moʦaʦan [r|ɾ]umiŋee ʦɨmɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a sua [r|ɾ]amaŋ ma[r|ɾ]ɨku[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]apɨ
S.TRANSL: 如果去放陷阱,就會觀察野獸所留下的足跡.
If they go to set up a trap, they would observe tracks left by animals.

FORM.notes: source note: "看"詞根結尾re為因 =in 黏著後音變的結果。

S.FORM: nuu cʉmʉreen sua ramang vavuru ia kamanʉng kee m sua ringee vavuru.
S.PHON: nuu ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]een sua [r|ɾ]amaŋ vavu[r|ɾ]u ia kamanɨŋ kee m sua [r|ɾ]iŋee vavu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: nuu cʉmʉreen sua ramang vavuru ia kamanʉng kee m sua ringee vavuru.
S.PHON: nuu ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]een sua [r|ɾ]amaŋ vavu[r|ɾ]u ia kamanɨŋ kee m sua [r|ɾ]iŋee vavu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: 若看到山豬的足跡,就製作山豬的陷阱.
If (the hunter) sees tracks left by boars, he/she would make a boar trap.

S.FORM: cʉmʉreen nen ramang to'orung ia humar kamanʉng kee ringee to'orung.
S.PHON: ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]een nen [r|ɾ]amaŋ toʔo[r|ɾ]uŋ ia huma[r|ɾ] kamanɨŋ kee [r|ɾ]iŋee toʔo[r|ɾ]uŋ
S.FORM: cʉmʉreen nen ramang to'orung ia humar kamanʉng kee ringee to'orung.
S.PHON: ʦɨmɨ[r|ɾ]een nen [r|ɾ]amaŋ toʔo[r|ɾ]uŋ ia huma[r|ɾ] kamanɨŋ kee [r|ɾ]iŋee toʔo[r|ɾ]uŋ
S.TRANSL: 若看到山羌的足跡,就製作山羌的陷阱.
If (the hunter) sees tracks left by the barking deer, he/she would make a barking deer trap.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處masua等同makasua。 | source note: tʉnʉvu專指獵寮，和taru'an不同。

S.FORM: uh masuacu nuu nimuringeeci ia muacacu mosa te ta tʉtʉnʉvu taru'anni.
S.PHON: uh masuaʦu nuu nimu[r|ɾ]iŋeeʦi ia muaʦaʦu mosa te ta tɨtɨnɨvu ta[r|ɾ]uʔanni
S.FORM: uh masuacu nuu nimuringeeci ia muacacu mosa te ta tʉtʉnʉvu taru'anni.
S.PHON: uh masuaʦu nuu nimu[r|ɾ]iŋeeʦi ia muaʦaʦu mosa te ta tɨtɨnɨvu ta[r|ɾ]uʔanni
S.TRANSL: 如果那樣做好了,已經放好陷阱了,就趕去他們的獵寮.
If things have been done like that, and they have set up the traps, they would then rush to go to their hunting sheds.

FORM.notes: source note: mo-taru'an為"在工寮過夜"之意。前綴mo-的可能來源有二：(1) mon 處於；(2) 焦點(AF)。 | source note: tanasU等同 tanasa "家屋"。tanasʉn則專指"部落、家鄉、社"。

S.FORM: eh nukai motaru'an nia ia muaca mu mutanasʉ mutanasʉ.
S.PHON: eh nukai mota[r|ɾ]uʔan nia ia muaʦa mu mutanasɨ mutanasɨ
S.FORM: eh nukai motaru'an nia ia muaca mu mutanasʉ mutanasʉ.
S.PHON: eh nukai mota[r|ɾ]uʔan nia ia muaʦa mu mutanasɨ mutanasɨ
S.TRANSL: 如果不在獵寮過夜,就回家.
If they are not staying overnight in the sheds, they would go back to their houses.

FORM.notes: source note: hara應為疑問詞kara。 | source note: sʉmʉrʉcʉ專指獵人在做了陷阱、回家、回獵寮等待之後，回到設陷阱處探查是否有動物被套住。

S.FORM: nuu kat mutan usʉpatʉ taniarahara sa urima taniara ia musaci nia musaci nia sʉmʉrʉcʉ sʉmʉrʉcʉ a sua uh ringee.
S.PHON: nuu kat mutan usɨpatɨ tania[r|ɾ]aha[r|ɾ]a sa u[r|ɾ]ima tania[r|ɾ]a ia musaʦi nia musaʦi nia sɨmɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ sɨmɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ a sua uh [r|ɾ]iŋee
S.FORM: nuu kat mutan usʉpatʉ taniarahara sa urima taniara ia musaci nia musaci nia sʉmʉrʉcʉ sʉmʉrʉcʉ a sua uh ringee.
S.PHON: nuu kat mutan usɨpatɨ tania[r|ɾ]aha[r|ɾ]a sa u[r|ɾ]ima tania[r|ɾ]a ia musaʦi nia musaʦi nia sɨmɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ sɨmɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ a sua uh [r|ɾ]iŋee
S.TRANSL: 四天或五天的時候,就去了那裏,探查陷阱.
When four or five days have passed, (the hunter) would go there and check the traps.

FORM.notes: source note: po-ringee中的前綴po-為表"打中"，和po-nasʉ '說得準確' 和po-cucuru '說真話/相信' 中的 po- '說' 不同。 | source note: Kanakanavu族中（以及其他台灣原住民族群），夢中的預兆對打獵是否成功非常重要。

S.FORM: nuu mamanʉngin ʉcʉpin ia una h hu poringee vavuru.
S.PHON: nuu mamanɨŋin ɨʦɨpin ia una h hu po[r|ɾ]iŋee vavu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: nuu mamanʉngin ʉcʉpin ia una h hu poringee vavuru.
S.PHON: nuu mamanɨŋin ɨʦɨpin ia una h hu po[r|ɾ]iŋee vavu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: 如果夢很好的話,就有陷阱中到山豬.
If (he/she) dreamed of something good, there will be traps successfully catching some boars.

FORM.notes: source note: ha為連接詞，表"或者"。

S.FORM: vavurukara ha to to'orung.
S.PHON: vavu[r|ɾ]uka[r|ɾ]a ha to toʔo[r|ɾ]uŋ
S.FORM: vavurukara ha to to'orung.
S.PHON: vavu[r|ɾ]uka[r|ɾ]a ha to toʔo[r|ɾ]uŋ
S.TRANSL: 是山豬呢,還是山羌?
Is it boars that are caught, or is it barking deers?

FORM.notes: source note: =kia和=ku的差別是，前者為長輩對晚輩所使用的詞。

S.FORM: ah miana nuu masuin ia macancangarUkia.
S.PHON: ah miana nuu masuin ia maʦanʦaŋa[r|ɾ]ukia
S.FORM: ah miana nuu masuin ia macancangarUkia.
S.PHON: ah miana nuu masuin ia maʦanʦaŋa[r|ɾ]ukia
S.TRANSL: 以前,如果那樣的話,我就很高興.
In the past, if something like that happens, I would be very pleased.

FORM.notes: source note: tanaha同tanasa。 | source note: puringee同poringee。

S.FORM: pu'i pu'i tanaha nuu nipuringeekia marʉkurakurapʉ.
S.PHON: puʔi puʔi tanaha nuu nipu[r|ɾ]iŋeekia ma[r|ɾ]ɨku[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]apɨ
S.FORM: pu'i pu'i tanaha nuu nipuringeekia marʉkurakurapʉ.
S.PHON: puʔi puʔi tanaha nuu nipu[r|ɾ]iŋeekia ma[r|ɾ]ɨku[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]apɨ
S.TRANSL: 如果陷阱有中野獸,我就回家.
I would go home if I caught some beasts with the traps.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處mose同mokusa和較縮減的mosa，應是=ci黏著的關係而產生音變。 | source note: 女人單數為nanakʉ，複數為nannakʉ。和較典型的重疊規則不同，仍不確定該如何標記。 | source note: sii語意為"因為"。

S.FORM: museci tanasa ia macangcangarʉ sua uh ta kat tanam nannakʉ tanasa sii m nipuringeekia marʉkurakurapʉ.
S.PHON: museʦi tanasa ia maʦaŋʦaŋa[r|ɾ]ɨ sua uh ta kat tanam nannakɨ tanasa sii m nipu[r|ɾ]iŋeekia ma[r|ɾ]ɨku[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]apɨ
S.FORM: museci tanasa ia macangcangarʉ sua uh ta kat tanam nannakʉ tanasa sii m nipuringeekia marʉkurakurapʉ.
S.PHON: museʦi tanasa ia maʦaŋʦaŋa[r|ɾ]ɨ sua uh ta kat tanam nannakɨ tanasa sii m nipu[r|ɾ]iŋeekia ma[r|ɾ]ɨku[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]apɨ
S.TRANSL: 回到家了,家裡的女人們就很高興,因為我有中到野獸.
After (my) coming home, the women in the house would be happy, because I had caught some beasts with the traps.

S.TRANSL: 如果那樣的話,我就要把中到的野獸剝皮,看是山豬呢,還是山羌.
If something like that happens, I will skin what I have caught with the traps, depending on whether it is a boar or a barking deer.

S.TRANSL: 那樣了之後,就有人來,聚集在一起看中到的獵物.
After that, there will be people coming over, gathering to see what has been caught by the traps.

S.TRANSL: 我將野獸剝皮,做成肉塊,煮肉,分給來的人.
I would skin the beast, cut it into meat chunks, cook them, and hand it out to the people who came.

If something like that happens, the people who came to visit would be very pleased.
